description: This file defines serialization interfaces and classes for MemoryMessageBody objects used in Orleans in-memory stream provider, including serializer implementation, message body class, and related serialization logic.

classes.name: IMemoryMessageBodySerializer
classes.description: Interface for serializing and deserializing MemoryMessageBody objects.

classes.name: DefaultMemoryMessageBodySerializer
classes.description: Default implementation of IMemoryMessageBodySerializer, using Orleans.Serializer.

classes.name: MemoryMessageBody
classes.description: Represents the message body used by the in-memory stream provider, containing events and request context.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes a MemoryMessageBody into a byte array segment.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a byte array segment into a MemoryMessageBody.

methods.name: OnDeserialized
methods.description: Callback invoked after deserialization to reinitialize the serializer using dependency injection.

methods.name: MemoryMessageBody
methods.description: Constructor initializing the message body with events and request context.
